read.thesis: IBM closed 2025 with 6% revenue growth, $14.7B free cash flow and software at 9%; 2026 guide of 5%+ revenue, software ~10% and FCF up ~$1B, with Confluent dilution of ~$600M.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 9%, highest in 3+ years
triggers.quote: Delivered total revenue growth of 9%, our highest level in over three years.

triggers.label: Consulting in 'very aggressive pricing environment'
triggers.quote: we are operating in a very aggressive pricing environment. We'll continue monitoring that.

triggers.label: Infrastructure to decline low single digits in 2026
triggers.quote: We expect infrastructure revenue to be down low single digits.

triggers.label: Red Hat growth decelerated to 8% in Q4
triggers.quote: Red Hat decelerated to 8%, driven partially by the wrap on last year's elevated consumption-based services

triggers.label: Q4 ACV bookings single-digit growth
triggers.quote: We only delivered single-digit ACV bookings in the fourth quarter because as we stated in prepared remarks, we were disrupted by the down of the federal government.

guidance.quote: we expect to sustain constant currency revenue growth of 5% plus in 2026
free cash flow to be up about $1 billion year over year
Which we expect to grow 10% this year.
support an acceleration in revenue growth to low to mid-single digits for the year
We expect infrastructure revenue to be down low single digits.
we expect IBM's operating pretax margin to expand by about a point.
We continue to accelerate our productivity initiatives and now expect an incremental $1 billion of productivity savings this year.
We anticipate absorbing about $600 million of dilution from Confluent in 2026.

prior_guidance_check.quote: 100 basis points of operating pretax margin expansion
$14.7 billion of free cash flow, growing 16% over last year

red_flags.label: Q4 federal ACV bookings single-digit
red_flags.quote: We only delivered single-digit ACV bookings in the fourth quarter because as we stated in prepared remarks, we were disrupted by the down of the federal government.

red_flags.label: Aggressive consulting pricing
red_flags.quote: we are operating in a very aggressive pricing environment.

red_flags.label: GenAI book metric discontinued
red_flags.quote: This will be the last quarter in which we report this metric separately.

evasions.topic: Red Hat growth bridge to mid-teens
evasions.quote: the word choices were being prudent. On Red Hat's guidance right now.
